name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Strawberry Pop Rocks
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Strawberry Pop Rocks half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Strawberry Pop Rocks brings a fun, candy-forward profile: ripe, juicy strawberry up front with a fizzy, crackling sweetness and a smooth, sugary finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Strawberry Pop Rocks flavor — juicy strawberry with a fizzy candy snap

My Zypps Strawberry Pop Rocks is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
